summary: While chanting, friendly players within 20' halve their Charge Incantation repetitions (rounded down, minimum 1); the bearer is Stopped.

effects.subject: friendly-players

params.factor: Charge Incantation repetitions divided by 2, rounded down, to a minimum of 1

effects.note: Friendly players within 20' of the bearer.

restrictions.note: Players can only benefit from one instance of Song of Power at a time.

termination.note: Must follow all Chant rules; the Enchantment ends when the Chant stops.
Song of Power ends if the bearer moves from their starting location.

properties.note: Chant "Song of Power" or sing an inspiring song.

clarifications.text: Singing in place of the normal Chant is still a Chant and must follow all Chant rules (stopping the Chant ends the song).

open_questions: E1 'friendly players within 20' of the bearer': the text does not say whether the bearer counts as one of them.
